metadataSchema.label: Topic Type
metadataSchema.description: DITA topic type: concept (explanations/architecture), task (ordered procedures/how-tos), or reference (APIs/schemas/tables).

metadataSchema.label: Journey Stage
metadataSchema.description: Where in the customer journey this topic sits (e.g. Evaluate, Plan, Build, Maintain). The organization's stage names are managed on the Content Gaps page, not here — this field just carries the value per topic.

metadataSchema.label: Use Cases
metadataSchema.description: Which of the organization's defined use cases this topic covers (see the Content Gaps page). Drives the demand-side coverage matrix — a topic with no use case tag is invisible to it.

useCases.name: Device Implantation
useCases.description: The physical procedure of preparing, inserting, and fixing the lead.
